description:
Using FreeCAD's Part Design workbench, create an Additive Loft solid that transitions from a circular profile (40 mm diameter, centered at origin) on the XY plane to a square profile (30 mm x 30 mm, centered at origin) on a plane 60 mm above (Z = 60 mm). 

Expected workflow:
1. Create a Sketch on the XY plane with a 40mm diameter circle.
2. Create a Datum Plane (or use an offset) at Z=60mm.
3. Create a Sketch on the new plane with a 30x30mm square.
4. Use the Additive Loft tool to create the solid.
5. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/loft_transition.FCStd'.
